turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on describing appearance?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Sure.

Appearance: **has** + hair/eyes (She has long hair). Personality: **is** + adjective (He is kind).
Remember: he/she → has; I/you/they → have.

Exercise: Complete with has or have:
"My cousin ___ brown eyes."
